title: Daintily
summary: DA'INTILY, adverb 1. Nicely; elegantly; as a hat daintily made. 2. Nicely; fastidiously; with nice regard to what is well tasted; as, to eat daintily 3. Deliciously; as, to fare daintily 4. Ceremoniou

inlines.v: DA'INTILY, adverb 1. Nicely; elegantly; as a hat daintily made. 2. Nicely; fastidiously; with nice regard to what is well tasted; as, to eat daintily 3. Deliciously; as, to fare daintily 4. Ceremoniously; scrupulously.
